During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''transport''' carrying [[Ayelixe Fabrico/Legends|Ayelixe Fabrico]] textiles once exploded in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]], scattering its cargo for kilometers.<ref name="Fleeced">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Fleeced}}</ref>
